matching_source.author: Alper Ferudun
matching_source.title: Unbounded Multiplicity in the Dilatation Spectrum of Every Term of the Johnson Filtration: An Observation on a Question of Farb

validated_scope: For every fixed closed genus g>=2 and fixed k>=3, all-pseudo-Anosov dilatation multiplicities are unbounded when counting orientation-preserving ambient Mod_g classes; proper powers are allowed and the common value may vary.

proof_interface_results.all_genus_square_tiled_seed: PASS: explicit seeds and connected sums at good points.
proof_interface_results.whole_signed_saddle_lattice: PASS: no assumption of orientable homology on the original surface.
proof_interface_results.full_affine_derivative_overgroup: PASS: the entire derivative image lies in PSL(Lambda); no finite-index claim is needed.
proof_interface_results.ambient_orientation_preserving_conjugacy: PASS: unique invariant disk and the affine stabilizer identification.
proof_interface_results.fixed_deep_rank2_free_subgroup: PASS: a nontrivial noncommuting free basis in I(2d)<=I(k).
proof_interface_results.universal_trace_families: PASS: symbolic reversal/substitution induction and cyclic-gap nonconjugacy.
proof_interface_results.uniform_fusion_including_proper_powers: PASS: C=3|V(Y)| for one fixed finite subtree, independent of m and exponents.
proof_interface_results.dilatation_normalization: PASS: lambda+lambda^-1=|t|; no square or factor-two discrepancy.
